content:
Jordan H: quick FYI — noticed the new route-affinity experiment is causing tenant context to stick across tabs. Repro steps below.
Maria C: @Jordan can you paste the exact steps?
Jordan H: open org A dashboard -> click "model runs" -> open a new tab, hit the model-run URL for org B -> backend rows are for org-b but the console header/telemetry still shows org-a. cc @Owen L
Owen L: that sounds like header stickiness in our routing middleware. which headers are being set?
Jordan H: we send `x-tenant-id` and `x-routing-affinity: sticky`. minimal curl: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-tenant-id: org-b" -H "x-routing-affinity: sticky" https://console.redwood/api/model/runs
```
Leah P: I can repro in Chrome. Quick-switch leaves the UI tenant selector tied to the first tab's workspace. Backend returns org-b rows but UI shows org-a in the header and telemetry selects the wrong scope.
Kai S: my guess: route middleware caches last-tenant on session and console reads tenant from session/localStorage, so subsequent tabs get stale UI context.
Jordan H: gateway traces show: 
```
[2026-02-14T10:12:03Z] incoming: x-tenant-id=org-b x-routing-affinity=sticky session=abcd
[2026-02-14T10:12:03Z] routed to backend pool=dedicated-A tenant=org-b
[2026-02-14T10:12:03Z] session-lookup returned tenant=org-a
```
Maria C: session-lookup returning org-a even when header says org-b is definitely wrong — seems we prioritize session->tenant when affinity=sticky.
Owen L: on it. Hypothesis: session map keying uses cookie + affinity flag; code path prefers session mapping over explicit header. Proposed fix: if explicit `x-tenant-id` present, it should override for console endpoints (but see security note).
Leah P: UX/security question: should header override always be allowed or only for admin/system routes? We need to ensure users can't impersonate other orgs.
Jordan H: agree. Security rule: allow header override only when the token belongs to a user who is a member of the target tenant (membership check). Otherwise return 403. Also log an audit event when override occurs.
Kai S: rolling a canary patch now to routing middleware to honor `x-tenant-id` when token membership validated.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-02-14T10:45 started: infra/routing v2.3.1 -> group A :rocket:
Maria C: I'll add a telemetry alert that fires when UI-tenant != backend-tenant for any request path, that should catch regressions.
Jordan H: leaving this thread open until session-lookup fix is confirmed and we add an e2e regression test.
Leah P: created e2e test with steps + assertions, PR #4821 incoming.
Owen L: PR merged to main, canary metrics look good, no new repros seen in last 20m.
Jordan H: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
